adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a raw `fetch` `Response` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). In HubSpot’s `CalendarService`, the result is typed/used as `HubspotToken` (`const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` in packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts), but with sync enabled it will actually be a `Response` object, so token fields like `expiresIn`/`refresh_token` won’t exist. This will lead to incorrect expiry computation (NaN) and incorrect credential persistence when the code later uses that token object.
